text.tspan: USB alone: programming only; outputs inhibited.
GPIO47 HIGH inhibits. GPIO48 fresh edge arms.
Stop opening / driver-rail loss clears the latch.
Closure / power return never automatically re-arms.
NOT a certified E-stop, STO or brake controller.
UV_OK and OV_N must both be valid; AUX15V_BAD clears the S3 enable latches.
